Thanks for the quick reply on the RFP checklist. We're ready to move into a technical walkthrough focused on VPC/on-prem requirements and the air-gapped option. Our networking team wants a tightly scoped, 60-minute session that covers:
- network topology expectations (NAT, egress controls)
- cert/key exchange and KMS approach

Appreciate it — looking to lock this in so procurement/IT can finish their internal signoffs.

Hi Aria — thanks for the diagram and the scope. 60 minutes works; we usually recommend the following 60-minute agenda to keep the session actionable:

1) 5m: Introductions + goals
2) 20m: Network topology walk (Medallion diagram + required ports/routing)
3) 15m: Key management / certs + audit logs
4) 10m: Operational runbook and failover modes (regional fallback, air-gap restore)
5) 10m: Action items & next steps

Proposed slots (PST):
- Mon Aug 9, 1:30–2:30pm
- Tue Aug 10, 3:00–4:00pm
- Wed Aug 11, 11:00–12:00pm

Marcus will cover KV-cache and runtime fallbacks; Aditya will handle security/audit-log integration details.

If one of those works, we can send an invite and a short pre-read (network checklist + agenda).

Cheers,

Kimberly Park
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
kimberly_park@redwood.ai
